Contributing to cyclingpower

Source: .github/CONTRIBUTING.md

Issues and pull requests are welcome. This is a one-maintainer package, so please open an issue before starting anything large — it may already be a deliberate omission.

Before you start

devtools::install_dev_deps()
devtools::load_all()
devtools::test()
devtools::check()

FITfileR is not on CRAN and is fetched from the Remotes: entry. Without it the FIT tests skip rather than fail; everything else still runs.

How this package is tested

This is the part worth reading before you write a test.

A characterisation test on a real ride file shows only that the code ran. The suite instead plants a distortion it chose and asserts the machinery recovers it — see tests/testthat/helper-synthetic.R for make_source() (gain, offset, lag, noise), make_level_dependent() and featureless_rides(), and demo_rides() for a whole set of files with known answers in them. When you add a capability, plant a known answer for it. Do not pin whatever the code currently emits.

Two traps that will bite you:

  • Anything touching the bootstrap must be wrapped in withr::with_seed() or it is flaky.
  • A pure gain with no noise gives every second an identical log ratio, so the bootstrap distribution is degenerate and the interval collapses to a point. That is correct. Add noise when testing that an interval brackets a value.

The recorder

R/record.R and inst/shiny/www/record.js read power meters over Web Bluetooth. The packet parser is tested under V8 and the file writing is tested normally. The radio path — requestDevice, the GATT connection, notifications, the reconnection loop, the wake lock — is not tested and cannot be. It needs a physical meter, a paired browser and a user gesture.

Please do not add a mock for it. A mock here would test the mock, not the parser the browser actually runs, and the credibility of the rest of the suite rests on the untested part being visibly marked rather than papered over.

Several things in that file look like they could be simplified and cannot:

  • Samples are batched at 500 ms because Shiny collapses repeat setInputValue calls of the same name within a tick, which silently loses samples from a 4 Hz meter.
  • A gap is never padded with zeros. Zeros read as coasting, coasting is dropped as a second both meters agreed on, and a dropped connection would then enter the comparison as evidence of agreement.
  • Stopping is ordered: a capture-phase click listener queues the final batch before Shiny sends the button press, and the input$samples observer has priority = 10 against the stop observer’s -10.
  • record.js addresses #pair_meter and #stop_record directly, so the app’s Record tab must not be wrapped in a Shiny module namespace.

Do not add trainer control. It was considered and rejected; the reasoning is in CLAUDE.md. The package emits a workout file and something else rides it.

Code style

  • Native pipe |>, <- for assignment, snake_case.
  • Explicit pkg:: prefixes in R/. Shiny is in Suggests, so the app code qualifies every call rather than attaching the package.
  • .groups = "drop" in every summarise().
  • Comments explain why, not what.
  • Minimal defensive coding. Errors are for genuine boundaries — an unreadable file, an impossible chain — not for guarding internal states.
  • NAMESPACE and man/ are roxygen-generated. Run devtools::document(); never hand-edit them.

Pull requests

Fork, branch, and make sure devtools::check() is clean before you open it. Add a bullet to NEWS.md for anything a user would notice.
